info.name: Get the SLO for an SLX

params.name: detail
params.description: Accepted for Django parity; ignored (always returns full detail)

items.docs:
Get the SLO for an SLX.

SLX and SLO have a 1:1 relationship. This endpoint returns the single
SLO associated with the specified SLX, or 404 if no SLO exists.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    slx_short_name: The SLX short name.
    _detail: Django parity query param (ignored).
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The SLO details.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace, SLX, or SLO not found.

info.name: Get SLO objective recommendation for an SLX

params.name: baseline
params.description: PromQL timestring defining the baseline window for the burn-rate calculation (e.g. '2h', '1d'). Defaults to hours elapsed since the 1st of the current month. Only used when an SLO exists. Must not exceed hours since month start.

items.docs:
Calculate a recommended SLO objective for an SLX.

Two paths:
- **Has SLO:** Recommends based on the current month's error budget burn rate.
- **No SLO:** Recommends based on 30 days of historical SLI healthiness data.

Mirrors Django's SloViewSet.slo_objective_recommendation().
